\(a\) The Second Lien Term Loan shall bear interest at a rate per annum equal to the Adjusted Term SOFR Rate plus the Applicable Margin.

\(b\) The Applicable Margin for the Second Lien Term Loan shall be 7.25% (725 basis points).

\(c\) The Term SOFR Rate shall be deemed to be not less than 1.00% (100 basis points) per annum (the \"SOFR Floor\").

\(d\) Interest shall be payable in arrears on each Interest Payment Date.

\(e\) Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the applicable interest rate shall increase by 2.00% per annum above the rate otherwise applicable hereunder (the \"Default Rate\"). Interest at the Default Rate shall accrue from the date of such Event of Default until such Event of Default is cured or waived and shall be payable on demand.

**[Section 2.05 --- Repayment; Amortization]{.underline}**

\(a\) The Borrower shall repay to the Lenders the aggregate outstanding principal amount of the Second Lien Term Loan on the Maturity Date.

\(b\) The Second Lien Term Loan shall not be subject to scheduled amortization payments.

**[Section 2.06 --- Prepayments]{.underline}**

\(a\) *Voluntary Prepayments.* The Borrower may, upon not less than three (3) Business Days\' prior written notice to the Administrative Agent, voluntarily prepay the Second Lien Term Loan in whole or in part; *provided* that (i) no Payment Default or Bankruptcy Event of Default (each as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement) then exists under the First Lien Credit Agreement, and (ii) after giving pro forma effect to such prepayment, the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio does not exceed 4.50 to 1.00. Each voluntary prepayment shall be in a minimum principal amount of \$1,000,000 and in integral multiples of \$500,000 in excess thereof (or, if less, the entire outstanding principal amount of the Second Lien Term Loan).

\(b\) *Mandatory Prepayments.* The Second Lien Term Loan shall not be subject to any mandatory prepayment requirements, whether from Excess Cash Flow, asset sale proceeds, or otherwise. All asset sale and insurance/condemnation proceeds shall be applied in accordance with the Intercreditor Agreement.

\(c\) Each prepayment shall be accompanied by accrued and unpaid interest on the principal amount prepaid through and including the date of prepayment.

**[ARTICLE VI --- COLLATERAL AND SECURITY (Selected Provisions)]{.underline}**

**[Section 6.01 --- Grant of Security Interest]{.underline}**

To secure the prompt payment and performance of the Second Lien Obligations, each Loan Party hereby grants to the Collateral Agent, for the benefit of the Second Lien Secured Parties, a second-priority security interest in and Lien upon all of such Loan Party\'s right, title, and interest in, to, and under all Collateral, whether now owned or hereafter acquired. Such Liens shall be junior and subordinate in all respects to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, as more fully set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement.

**[Section 6.02 --- Collateral Description]{.underline}**

The Collateral shall consist of substantially all assets of the Borrower and each Guarantor, including:

\(a\) *Real Property.*

> \(i\) 7100 Industrial Parkway, Dayton, OH 45414 (headquarters and main manufacturing plant, approximately 320,000 square feet; appraised value: \$42,000,000);
>
> \(ii\) 2400 Commerce Drive, Tulsa, OK 74116 (fabrication plant, approximately 185,000 square feet; appraised value: \$28,500,000); and
>
> \(iii\) 1050 River Road, Baton Rouge, LA 70802 (assembly and testing facility, approximately 140,000 square feet; appraised value: \$17,000,000).
>
> Total appraised value of real property as of the Closing Date: \$87,500,000.

\(b\) *Personal Property.* All equipment (net book value as of the Closing Date: approximately \$94,200,000), inventory (approximately \$41,700,000 as of the Closing Date), accounts receivable (approximately \$62,300,000 as of the Closing Date), general intangibles, instruments, chattel paper, deposit accounts, investment property, letter-of-credit rights, commercial tort claims, and all other personal property of the Borrower and each Guarantor.

\(c\) *Intellectual Property.* Forty-seven (47) United States patents relating to thermal management technology, twelve (12) registered trademarks, proprietary design software, and all related licenses, royalties, and proceeds thereof.

\(d\) *Equity Interests.* One hundred percent (100%) of the Equity Interests of each Domestic Subsidiary (CTS Engineering Solutions, Inc., CTS Fabrication Services, LLC, CTS Assembly & Testing, LLC, and CTS IP Holdings, Inc.) and sixty-five percent (65%) of the voting Equity Interests of each first-tier Foreign Subsidiary (CTS Thermal Systems Canada, Ltd. and CTS Europe GmbH).

**[Section 6.03 --- Priority of Liens]{.underline}**

The Liens granted hereunder and under the Second Lien Collateral Documents shall be second-priority Liens, junior and subordinate to the first-priority Liens securing the First Lien Obligations. The relative priority of the Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations and the First Lien Obligations, and the rights and obligations of the parties with respect thereto, shall be governed by the Intercreditor Agreement. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of this Article VI and the Intercreditor Agreement, the Intercreditor Agreement shall control.

**[ARTICLE VIII --- EVENTS OF DEFAULT (Selected Provisions)]{.underline}**

**[Section 8.01 --- Events of Default]{.underline}**

Each of the following shall constitute an \"Event of Default\" under this Agreement:

\(a\) *Payment Default.* Failure by the Borrower to pay when due any principal of the Second Lien Term Loan (a \"**Payment Default**\").

\(b\) *Interest/Fee Payment Default.* Failure by the Borrower to pay any interest on

the Second Lien Term Loan or any fee or other amount payable hereunder or under any other Loan Document within five (5) Business Days after the date when due.

\(c\) *Representation and Warranty Default.* Any representation or warranty made or deemed made by any Loan Party in this Agreement or in any other Loan Document, or in any certificate, document, or financial statement delivered in connection herewith or therewith, shall prove to have been incorrect in any material respect when made or deemed made.

\(d\) *Covenant Default.* Failure by any Loan Party to perform or observe any covenant or agreement contained in this Agreement or any other Loan Document (other than those described in clauses (a) and (b) above), and such failure shall continue unremedied for a period of thirty (30) days after the earlier of (i) written notice thereof from the Administrative Agent to the Borrower and (ii) the date on which a Responsible Officer of the Borrower has actual knowledge of such failure.

\(e\) *Cross-Default.* The occurrence of an event of default under any agreement or instrument evidencing or governing Indebtedness of the Borrower or any Subsidiary in an aggregate principal amount exceeding \$15,000,000 (other than Indebtedness under this Agreement), or any such Indebtedness shall be declared to be due and payable or required to be prepaid (other than by a regularly scheduled required prepayment) prior to its stated maturity.

\(f\) *Bankruptcy.* The commencement of an involuntary or voluntary case or proceeding under any Debtor Relief Law by or against the Borrower, Holdings, or any Material Subsidiary (a \"**Bankruptcy Event of Default**\"), including the filing of a petition in bankruptcy, the appointment of a receiver, trustee, or custodian, or the making of an assignment for the benefit of creditors; *provided* that, with respect to any involuntary case or proceeding, such case or proceeding shall not have been dismissed within sixty (60) days of the commencement thereof.

\(g\) *Judgment Default.* One or more final, non-appealable judgments, orders, or decrees for the payment of money in an aggregate amount exceeding \$15,000,000 (to the extent not covered by insurance as to which the insurer has acknowledged coverage) shall be rendered against the Borrower, any Guarantor, or any combination thereof and shall remain undischarged for a period of sixty (60) consecutive days during which execution shall not be effectively stayed.

\(h\) *ERISA.* The occurrence of one or more ERISA Events that, individually or in the aggregate, could reasonably be expected to result in liability of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries in an aggregate amount exceeding \$10,000,000.

\(i\) *Invalidity of Loan Documents.* Any material provision of any Loan Document shall at any time for any reason cease to be valid and binding on any Loan Party, or any Lien purported to be created by any Second Lien Collateral Document shall cease to be a valid and perfected Lien on the Collateral (with the priority required hereby or by the applicable Second Lien Collateral Document), except to the extent permitted by the Intercreditor Agreement.

\(j\) *Change of Control.* The occurrence of a Change of Control.

**[Section 8.02 --- Remedies]{.underline}**

\(a\) Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may, and at the request of the Required Lenders shall, by notice to the Borrower, (i) declare all outstanding Second Lien Obligations to be immediately due and payable, without presentment, demand, protest, or other notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived by each Loan Party, (ii) require the Borrower to cash collateralize any outstanding obligations, and (iii) exercise any and all rights and remedies available to the Second Lien Secured Parties under the Loan Documents, at law, or in equity.

\(b\) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Section 8.02, the exercise of any remedies with respect to the Collateral (including the commencement of any foreclosure action, the exercise of any right of sale, or any other action to enforce any Lien on the Collateral) shall be subject to the terms and conditions of the Intercreditor Agreement, including any applicable standstill period set forth therein.

\(c\) In the event of any Bankruptcy Event of Default described in Section 8.01(f), all outstanding Second Lien Obligations shall automatically become immediately due and payable without any declaration or other act on the part of the Administrative Agent or any Lender.

**[ARTICLE IX --- MISCELLANEOUS (Selected Provisions)]{.underline}**

**[Section 9.18 --- Intercreditor Matters]{.underline}**

\(a\) *Acknowledgement and Consent.* Each Second Lien Lender, by its acceptance of the benefits of this Agreement, (i) acknowledges that it has received a copy of the Intercreditor Agreement, (ii) consents to the subordination of the Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations on the terms set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement, and (iii) agrees to be bound by the terms thereof.

\(b\) *DIP Financing.* Each Second Lien Lender agrees that, in any Insolvency Proceeding, it will not object to, and hereby consents to, any debtor-in-possession financing provided to the Borrower or any Guarantor that is secured by Liens on the Collateral with priority equal to or senior to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, provided that the aggregate principal amount of such debtor-in-possession financing does not exceed the sum of (i) the aggregate principal amount outstanding under the First Lien Credit Agreement at the time of the filing of such Insolvency Proceeding, plus (ii) \$30,000,000.

\(c\) *Adequate Protection.* In any Insolvency Proceeding, each Second Lien Lender agrees that (i) it will not seek or accept adequate protection in the form of Liens on the Collateral that are senior to or pari passu with the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations (or any debtor-in-possession financing that refinances or replaces such obligations), and (ii) it will accept adequate protection solely in the form of (A) replacement Liens on the Collateral, which Liens shall be subordinated to (1) the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, (2) any Liens securing debtor-in-possession financing consented to under clause (b) above, and (3) any Liens securing adequate protection provided to the First Lien Secured Parties, and (B) superpriority administrative expense claims junior to all superpriority claims of the First Lien Secured Parties.

\(d\) *Asset Sales and Insurance/Condemnation.* Each Second Lien Lender agrees that all proceeds of Collateral received in connection with any sale, transfer, or other disposition of Collateral (including any sale under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code) or any insurance or condemnation proceeds with respect to Collateral shall be applied first to the payment in full of the First Lien Obligations before any application to the Second Lien Obligations. No Second Lien Lender shall object to any sale of Collateral consented to by the Required First Lien Lenders (as defined in the First Lien Credit Agreement).

\(e\) *Plan Voting.* In any Insolvency Proceeding, each Second Lien Lender agrees that it shall not vote in favor of any plan of reorganization (and shall not otherwise support any such plan) that is not accepted by the class of First Lien Lenders, unless the First Lien Obligations are to be paid in full in cash on the effective date of such plan. No Second Lien Lender shall propose or support any plan of reorganization that is inconsistent with the priorities and other terms set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Second Lien Lenders shall retain all rights to vote on any plan of reorganization to the extent such rights cannot be waived under applicable law.

\(f\) *Standstill.* Each Second Lien Lender acknowledges that the Intercreditor Agreement may contain standstill provisions restricting the exercise of remedies by the Second Lien Secured Parties with respect to the Collateral, and each Second Lien Lender agrees to be bound by such standstill provisions.

\(g\) *Purchase Option.* The Second Lien Secured Parties shall have the right (but not the obligation) to purchase all (but not less than all) of the First Lien Obligations from the First Lien Secured Parties at a purchase price equal to the full amount of the First Lien Obligations, including the aggregate outstanding principal amount thereof, all accrued and unpaid interest thereon, all fees (including any applicable premiums), and all other amounts owing in respect thereof, exercisable upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Intercreditor Agreement.

\(h\) *Automatic Release.* Each Second Lien Lender agrees that the Liens on any Collateral and any guarantee by any Guarantor shall be automatically released upon the release of the corresponding first-priority Liens or guarantees under the First Lien Credit Agreement, to the extent such release is in connection with a transaction permitted under the First Lien Credit Agreement.

\(i\) *Refinancing.* Each Second Lien Lender acknowledges and agrees that the First Lien Obligations may be refinanced from time to time, and any Permitted First Lien Refinancing Indebtedness shall be entitled to the benefits of the Intercreditor Agreement on substantially the same terms.

\(j\) *Amendment Restrictions.* Without the consent of the Required Lenders, no amendment, modification, or waiver of the Second Lien Credit Agreement or any other Second Lien Loan Document shall (i) shorten the Maturity Date to a date earlier than the date that is ninety-one (91) days after the maturity date under the First Lien Credit Agreement (currently July 16, 2031, based on a First Lien maturity of October 15, 2031), (ii) increase the aggregate principal amount of the Second Lien Term Loan Commitments to an amount in excess of \$115,000,000, (iii) add any financial maintenance covenants that are more restrictive than the financial maintenance covenants set forth in the First Lien Credit Agreement, or (iv) add any mandatory prepayment provisions.

**[ARTICLE XI --- THE AGENTS (Selected Provisions)]{.underline}**

**[Section 11.01 --- Appointment and Authorization]{.underline}**

\(a\) Each Lender hereby irrevocably appoints and authorizes Trident Capital Markets LLC to act as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent on its behalf under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents. Each Lender authorizes the Administrative Agent and the Collateral Agent to take such actions and exercise such powers as are delegated to such agent hereunder and under the other Loan Documents, together with all powers reasonably incidental thereto.

\(b\) The rights and duties of the Administrative Agent and the Collateral Agent are set forth solely in this Article XI and shall not be inferred from any other provision of this Agreement.

\(c\) Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Collateral Agent is authorized to execute and deliver the Second Lien Collateral Documents and to exercise all rights and remedies thereunder, subject to the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement.

**[Section 11.02 --- Intercreditor Agreement Authorization]{.underline}**

\(a\) Each Lender and each other Second Lien Secured Party hereby irrevocably authorizes and directs the Second Lien Collateral Agent to enter into the Intercreditor Agreement on behalf of such Lender and such Second Lien Secured Party and to bind such Lender and such Second Lien Secured Party to the terms and conditions thereof. Each Lender acknowledges that the Intercreditor Agreement may limit the exercise of rights and remedies of the Second Lien Secured Parties with respect to the Collateral and may contain waivers and agreements that affect the rights of the Second Lien Secured Parties in connection with any Insolvency Proceeding.

\(b\) The Second Lien Collateral Agent is authorized and directed to execute and deliver the Intercreditor Agreement on the Closing Date and to perform its obligations thereunder.

\(c\) In the event of any conflict between the terms of this Agreement and the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement, the terms of the Intercreditor Agreement shall govern and control.

**[Section 11.03 --- Reliance by Agents]{.underline}**

Each of the Administrative Agent and the Collateral Agent may rely, and shall be fully protected in acting or refraining from acting, upon any communication, instrument, or document believed by it in good faith to be genuine and correct and to have been signed, sent, or made by the proper Person. Neither the Administrative Agent nor the Collateral Agent shall be required to take any action that is inconsistent with the Intercreditor Agreement or any provision of this Agreement or applicable law. Neither the Administrative Agent nor the Collateral Agent shall be liable for any action taken or not taken by it in accordance with the Intercreditor Agreement.

**[ARTICLE XII --- GUARANTY (Selected Provisions)]{.underline}**

**[Section 12.01 --- Guaranty]{.underline}**

Each Guarantor hereby unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees to the Collateral Agent, for the benefit of the Second Lien Secured Parties, the punctual payment and performance when due of all Second Lien Obligations, whether at stated maturity, by acceleration, or otherwise, and including all interest, fees, indemnification obligations, and other amounts owing in respect of the Second Lien Obligations. The Guarantors as of the Closing Date are: CTS Acquisition Holdings, LLC; CTS Engineering Solutions, Inc.; CTS Fabrication Services, LLC; CTS Assembly & Testing, LLC; and CTS IP Holdings, Inc.

**[Section 12.02 --- Subordination of Guaranty]{.underline}**

The guarantee obligations of each Guarantor hereunder are subject to the terms and conditions of the Intercreditor Agreement. The rights of the Second Lien Secured Parties under this Article XII are junior and subordinate to the rights of the First Lien Secured Parties under the corresponding guaranty provisions of the First Lien Credit Agreement.

**[Additional Relevant Provisions (Miscellaneous Excerpts)]{.underline}**

**[Section 10.04 --- Governing Law]{.underline}**

THIS AGREEMENT AND THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES HEREUNDER SHALL BE GOVERNED BY, AND CONSTRUED AND INTERPRETED IN ACCORDANCE WITH, THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK.

**[Section 10.05 --- Notices]{.underline}**

All notices and other communications provided for herein shall be in writing and shall be delivered or sent to the applicable party at the following addresses (or at such other address as shall be designated by such party in a written notice to each other party):

> If to the **Borrower**: Consolidated Thermal Systems, Inc. 7100 Industrial Parkway Dayton, OH 45414
>
> Attention: Chief Financial Officer
>
> Telephone: (937) 555-4200
>
> If to **Holdings**: CTS Acquisition Holdings, LLC c/o Ridgeline Capital Partners IV, L.P. 400 Lexington Avenue, Suite 3200 New York, NY 10170
>
> Attention: General Counsel
>
> Telephone: (212) 555-8100
>
> If to the **Administrative Agent** or **Collateral Agent**: Trident Capital Markets LLC 1251 Avenue of the Americas, 40th Floor New York, NY 10020
>
> Attention: Agency Services Group
>
> Telephone: (212) 555-6300
>
> With a copy to counsel for the Second Lien Agent: Caldwell Reed LLP 700 Louisiana Street, Suite 4100 Houston, TX 77002
>
> Attention: Credit Finance Group
>
> Telephone: (713) 555-2400

**[Section 10.12 --- Second Lien Term Loan Commitment Amount]{.underline}**

The aggregate Second Lien Term Loan Commitment is \$115,000,000. The Second Lien Term Loan has no revolving component and no incremental facility.

**SIGNATURE BLOCK INDICATORS**

*\[Signature pages to the Second Lien Credit Agreement are not included in these excerpts.\]*

The anticipated signatories to the Second Lien Credit Agreement are as follows:

> • **CONSOLIDATED THERMAL SYSTEMS, INC.**, as Borrower
>
> • **CTS ACQUISITION HOLDINGS, LLC**, as Holdings and Guarantor
>
> • **TRIDENT CAPITAL MARKETS LLC**, as Administrative Agent and Collateral Agent
>
> • Each Lender party thereto
>
> • Each Guarantor party thereto:
>
> CTS Engineering Solutions, Inc. CTS Fabrication Services, LLC CTS Assembly & Testing, LLC CTS IP Holdings, Inc.

Linden & Harper CPAs serves as the independent auditor for the Borrower (referenced in Section 5.01 of the full agreement, not excerpted herein).

MH|1. Summary
P|Attached (following this memorandum) is a first draft of the First Lien / Second Lien Intercreditor Agreement (the “**ICA**”) among Pinnacle Credit Advisors LLC, as First Lien Collateral Agent (and, as discussed below, First Lien Administrative Agent), Trident Capital Markets LLC, as Second Lien Collateral Agent (and Second Lien Administrative Agent), and acknowledged by Consolidated Thermal Systems, Inc. (the “**Borrower**”) and CTS Acquisition Holdings, LLC (“**Holdings**”). The draft is first-lien-favorable and implements each of your October 11 instructions. It holds our position on all four points Caldwell Reed has previewed: (a) a 180-day Standstill Period; (b) adequate protection limited to junior replacement Liens and junior superpriority claims, with no cash adequate protection; (c) a DIP consent cap measured by all outstanding First Lien Obligations (not principal only) plus $30,000,000 of new money; and (d) a broad plan-voting restriction. Nothing has been pre-conceded.
P|In reviewing the First Lien and Second Lien credit agreement excerpts against the instructions, I identified a number of inconsistencies that we should resolve before the draft goes to Caldwell Reed on Monday. Several are not merely drafting points: (i) the Second Lien Credit Agreement contains an incorrect “91 days after First Lien maturity” date that your email also carries forward (the correct date is **January 14, 2032**, not July 16, 2031); (ii) the Second Lien Credit Agreement already contains a narrower, principal-only DIP cap and a plan-voting carve-out that Caldwell Reed will cite against us; (iii) the two credit agreements calculate the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio differently, which directly affects the 4.50x voluntary prepayment test; (iv) the standstill, as framed in the instructions, runs only from a notice delivered by the First Lien Agent, which (absent a fix) would leave the Second Lien free to enforce if we never send a notice; and (v) two of the First Lien amendment restrictions (no additional collateral; no increase in commitments) cut against the First Lien Secured Parties and conflict with the First Lien Credit Agreement’s own further-assurances and after-acquired property covenants. Each issue is flagged in a bracketed **[AKM Drafting Note]** at the relevant provision of the ICA and is summarized in the table in Part 3 below, ranked by priority.
P|I did not have access to the Meridian Industrial Partners 2023 precedent in the materials provided to me for this draft. The ICA has therefore been prepared on a market first-lien-favorable form tailored to this deal; before circulation, I will conform boilerplate (agency, reliance, bailee and miscellaneous provisions) to the Meridian form so that Caldwell Reed sees our house form, while preserving the deal-specific changes described here (the Meridian capital structure differed, so no provision has been imported by find-and-replace).

R|First Lien Obligations|Sec. 1.01|By reference to “First Lien Obligations” in the First Lien Credit Agreement, expressly including Hedging Obligations (up to $25,000,000 notional), Cash Management Obligations (up to $10,000,000), Protective Advances, the Prepayment Premium, Default Rate interest and Post-Petition Interest (whether or not allowed), fees, expenses and indemnities, and any First Lien DIP Financing.

R|Standstill|Sec. 3.01–3.03|180 days from delivery of an Enforcement Notice or Payment Blockage Notice (or, if none, from the First Lien Agent’s receipt of a Second Lien Enforcement Notice); tolled while the First Lien Agent is diligently pursuing enforcement; [restart on new Event of Default — bracketed]; 5 Business Days’ prior written notice before any post-standstill enforcement; all proceeds turned over and applied per the waterfall.
R|Payments / blockage|Sec. 4.01–4.03|Scheduled cash interest (non-default rate) permitted unless a First Lien Payment Default or First Lien Bankruptcy Default exists; principal blocked other than at stated maturity (October 15, 2032); voluntary prepayments only with no such default and pro forma First Lien Net Leverage Ratio ≤ 4.50:1.00 (First Lien Credit Agreement definition).
R|Waterfall|Sec. 4.04|First Lien Obligations paid in full; then Second Lien Obligations; then Borrower / as required by law. Insurance and condemnation proceeds follow the same waterfall. No objection to any sale consented to by Required First Lien Lenders.
R|DIP / cash collateral|Sec. 6.02|Deemed consent to First Lien DIP Financing up to outstanding First Lien Obligations plus $30,000,000 new money (DIP Cap) and to cash collateral use consented to by the First Lien Agent; no priming DIP support.
R|Adequate protection|Sec. 6.04|Second Lien limited to (a) junior replacement Liens and (b) junior superpriority claims. No cash payments, additional collateral or senior/pari administrative priority.
R|Plan voting|Sec. 6.10|No vote in favor of (or support for) any plan not accepted by the First Lien class unless First Lien Obligations are paid in full in cash on the effective date; no competing plan during the Standstill Period [or 180 days after the petition date, if later].
R|Purchase option|Art. 7|All (not less than all) First Lien Obligations at par plus accrued and unpaid interest plus fees then due and owing [plus Prepayment Premium and other amounts — bracketed, see Issue 9]; exercisable within 30 Business Days after First Lien Agent notice of acceleration or bankruptcy filing.
R|Releases|Sec. 5.01|Automatic and simultaneous release of Second Lien Liens and guarantees upon any release in a transaction permitted under the First Lien Credit Agreement (and in enforcement); deemed authorization; irrevocable power of attorney.

Should any Second Lien Secured Party, contrary to this Agreement, in any way take, attempt to take or threaten to take any action with respect to the Collateral, or fail to take any action required by this Agreement, the First Lien Agent or any other First Lien Secured Party (in its own name or in the name of the relevant Grantor) may obtain relief against such Second Lien Secured Party by injunction, specific performance or other appropriate equitable relief, it being understood and agreed by the Second Lien Agent on behalf of each Second Lien Secured Party that (a) the First Lien Secured Parties’ damages from such actions may at that time be difficult to ascertain and may be irreparable and (b) each Second Lien Secured Party waives any defense that the Grantors or the First Lien Secured Parties cannot demonstrate damage or can be made whole by the awarding of damages.
H|ARTICLE 4|PAYMENTS; PAYMENT BLOCKAGE; APPLICATION OF PROCEEDS
S|Section 4.01 Permitted Second Lien Payments.|Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the Borrower and the other Grantors may make, and the Second Lien Secured Parties may receive and retain, only the following payments in respect of the Second Lien Obligations (the “**Permitted Second Lien Payments**”):
I|(a) regularly scheduled payments of cash interest on the Second Lien Term Loan, at the non-default rate of interest set forth in Section 2.04(a) and (b) of the Second Lien Credit Agreement as in effect on the date hereof (or as increased in accordance with Section 8.01(b)), on the scheduled Interest Payment Dates therefor, but only if, at the time of such payment and after giving effect thereto, no First Lien Payment Default and no First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing;
I|(b) the payment of the outstanding principal amount of the Second Lien Term Loan on the Second Lien Maturity Date (October 15, 2032), but only if no First Lien Payment Default and no First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing;
I|(c) voluntary prepayments of the Second Lien Term Loan permitted under Section 4.03; and
I|(d) payment of reasonable and documented out-of-pocket costs, expenses and indemnities of the Second Lien Agent (in its capacity as such) under the Second Lien Documents, [in an aggregate amount not to exceed $[●] in any fiscal year,] so long as no First Lien Payment Default and no First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing.
P|All other payments of principal, premium, fees and other amounts in respect of the Second Lien Obligations (including interest at the Default Rate under Section 2.04(e) of the Second Lien Credit Agreement, which may accrue but shall not be paid in cash while a First Lien Payment Default or First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing) are prohibited until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations. N|Per instructions: interest permitted unless a payment or bankruptcy Event of Default exists under the 1L CA; principal blocked other than at stated maturity. S|Section 4.02 Payment Blockage.|Upon the occurrence of any First Lien Payment Default or First Lien Bankruptcy Default, the First Lien Agent may (and, as required by Section 12.15(a) of the First Lien Credit Agreement, shall) deliver a Payment Blockage Notice to the Second Lien Agent (with a copy to the Borrower); provided that the prohibitions in Section 4.01 shall apply whether or not a Payment Blockage Notice has been delivered, and the failure of the First Lien Agent to deliver a Payment Blockage Notice shall not affect the rights of any First Lien Secured Party hereunder. S|Section 4.03 Voluntary Prepayments of Second Lien Term Loan.|The Borrower may voluntarily prepay the Second Lien Term Loan, in whole or in part, and the Second Lien Secured Parties may receive and retain such prepayment, only if (a) no First Lien Payment Default and no First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing or would result therefrom, and (b) the Borrower has delivered to the First Lien Agent, not less than three (3) Business Days prior to the date of such prepayment, a certificate of a responsible officer of the Borrower demonstrating in reasonable detail that, after giving pro forma effect to such prepayment (and any Indebtedness incurred and cash used in connection therewith), the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the most recently ended Test Period does not exceed 4.50 to 1.00. S|Section 4.04 Application of Proceeds.|So long as the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has not occurred, whether or not any Insolvency Proceeding has been commenced, all Collateral and all Proceeds thereof received by the First Lien Agent, the Second Lien Agent or any other Secured Party in connection with any Enforcement Action, any sale, transfer or other disposition of Collateral (including any sale under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code), any collection or other realization on the Collateral, any insurance or condemnation proceeds in respect of Collateral, or any distribution in any Insolvency Proceeding on account of the Collateral or the Liens thereon, shall be applied in the following order:

S|Section 4.05 Asset Sales; Insurance and Condemnation.|(a) The Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it will not object to, oppose or otherwise contest (and will be deemed to have consented to) any sale, transfer or other disposition of Collateral (whether in or outside of an Insolvency Proceeding, and including any sale under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code) that is consented to by the Required First Lien Lenders (or the First Lien Agent at their direction), and the Liens of the Second Lien Agent on such Collateral shall be released as provided in Section 5.01. (b) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the First Lien Agent shall have the sole and exclusive right, subject to the rights of the Grantors under the First Lien Documents, to settle and adjust claims in respect of Collateral under policies of insurance and to approve any award granted in any condemnation or similar proceeding affecting the Collateral. If the Second Lien Agent or any Second Lien Secured Party receives any such proceeds or award in contravention of this Section 4.05, it shall pay the same over to the First Lien Agent. P|(c) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of the other Second Lien Secured Parties, hereby irrevocably constitutes and appoints the First Lien Agent and any officer or agent of the First Lien Agent, with full power of substitution, as its true and lawful attorney-in-fact with full irrevocable power and authority in the place and stead of the Second Lien Agent or such holder or in the First Lien Agent’s own name, in the First Lien Agent’s discretion, for the purpose of carrying out the terms of this Section 5.01, to take any and all appropriate action and to execute any and all documents and instruments (including UCC-3 termination statements, mortgage releases and releases of guarantees) that may be necessary or desirable to accomplish the purposes of this Section 5.01. Clauses (ii) and (iii) extend the release to enforcement and bankruptcy sales, which is market for first-lien-favorable forms and goes beyond 2L CA §9.18(h); expect Caldwell Reed to request a “proceeds applied per waterfall” condition, which we have included in clause (ii).
S|Section 5.02 Amendments to Collateral Documents; Legend.|Each Second Lien Collateral Document shall be subject to this Agreement. Any amendment, waiver or consent to the First Lien Collateral Documents (other than any amendment restricted by Section 8.01) shall apply automatically to any comparable provision of the comparable Second Lien Collateral Document, without the consent of any Second Lien Secured Party, so long as notice is given to the Second Lien Agent and such amendment does not (a) remove assets subject to the Liens of the Second Lien Agent except to the extent such release is permitted by Section 5.01, or (b) impose duties on the Second Lien Agent without its consent.
S|Section 5.03 Rights as Unsecured Creditors.|Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement, the Second Lien Agent and the other Second Lien Secured Parties may exercise rights and remedies as unsecured creditors against the Borrower and any other Grantor in accordance with the terms of the Second Lien Documents and applicable law; provided that (a) no such action shall be taken that is inconsistent with, or would contravene, the terms of this Agreement (including Sections 3.01, 4.01, 6.02, 6.04 and 6.10), and (b) in the event that any Second Lien Secured Party becomes a judgment lien creditor in respect of Collateral as a result of its enforcement of its rights as an unsecured creditor, such judgment lien shall be subject to the terms of this Agreement for all purposes (including in relation to the First Lien Obligations) to the same extent as all other Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations.
S|Section 5.04 No Duties of First Lien Agent; Waiver of Marshalling.|The First Lien Agent and the other First Lien Secured Parties shall have no duty to the Second Lien Secured Parties in connection with the management, sale, disposition or other realization of the Collateral, other than to remit any surplus Proceeds after the Discharge of First Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 4.04. The Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of the other Second Lien Secured Parties, waives any right to assert or enforce any claim against the First Lien Secured Parties based on any action taken or omitted to be taken by them with respect to the Collateral in accordance with the First Lien Documents and this Agreement, and agrees not to assert, and hereby waives, to the fullest extent permitted by law, any right to demand, request, plead or otherwise assert or claim the benefit of any marshalling, appraisal, valuation or other similar right that may otherwise be available under applicable law with respect to the Collateral or any similar rights a junior secured creditor may have under applicable law.

(b) The First Lien Agent shall have no obligation whatsoever to the Second Lien Agent or any Second Lien Secured Party to ensure that the Pledged Collateral is genuine or owned by any Grantor or to preserve rights or benefits of any Person, except as expressly set forth in this Section 5.05. The duties or responsibilities of the First Lien Agent under this Section 5.05 shall be limited solely to holding the Pledged Collateral as bailee and agent in accordance herewith. (c) Upon the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the First Lien Agent shall deliver the remaining Pledged Collateral (if any), together with any necessary endorsements, to the Second Lien Agent, or as a court of competent jurisdiction may otherwise direct, without recourse, representation or warranty.
S|Section 5.06 Insurance Proceeds and Related Matters.|Without limiting Section 4.05, the Second Lien Agent shall cooperate with the First Lien Agent to cause the loss payee and additional insured endorsements required by Section 4.05(b) to be delivered within the time periods required by the First Lien Credit Agreement.

H|ARTICLE 2|LIEN PRIORITIES
S|Section 2.01 Relative Priorities.|Notwithstanding (a) the date, time, order, manner or method of grant, creation, attachment or perfection of any Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations granted on the Collateral or of any Liens securing the First Lien Obligations granted on the Collateral, (b) any provision of the UCC, any other applicable law or the Second Lien Documents or the First Lien Documents, (c) any defect or deficiency in, or failure to attach or perfect, any Lien securing any First Lien Obligations, or the avoidance, invalidation, lapse, subordination or unenforceability of any such Lien, (d) the date on which any Obligations are extended, or (e) any other circumstance whatsoever, the Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, hereby agrees that: (i) any Lien on the Collateral securing any First Lien Obligations now or hereafter held by or on behalf of the First Lien Agent or any First Lien Secured Party, or any agent or trustee therefor, regardless of how acquired, whether by grant, possession, statute, operation of law, subrogation or otherwise, shall be senior in all respects and prior to any Lien on the Collateral securing any Second Lien Obligations; and (ii) any Lien on the Collateral securing any Second Lien Obligations now or hereafter held by or on behalf of the Second Lien Agent or any Second Lien Secured Party, or any agent or trustee therefor, regardless of how acquired, whether by grant, possession, statute, operation of law, subrogation or otherwise, shall be junior and subordinate in all respects to all Liens on the Collateral securing any First Lien Obligations. All Liens on the Collateral securing any First Lien Obligations shall be and remain senior in all respects and prior to all Liens on the Collateral securing any Second Lien Obligations for all purposes, whether or not such Liens securing any First Lien Obligations are subordinated to any Lien securing any other obligation of any Grantor or any other Person.
S|Section 2.02 Perfection Not a Condition to Priority.|The priorities set forth in Section 2.01 are applicable irrespective of, and shall not be altered, limited or impaired by, any defect in, or the failure, lapse or avoidance of, the attachment, perfection or priority of any Lien securing any First Lien Obligations. The Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it shall not assert, and hereby waives, any claim or argument that any Lien securing the Second Lien Obligations has priority over, or is pari passu with, any Lien securing the First Lien Obligations by reason of any such defect, failure, lapse or avoidance. The First Lien Agent and the other First Lien Secured Parties shall have no obligation to the Second Lien Secured Parties to perfect or maintain the perfection of any Lien. If any Lien securing First Lien Obligations is avoided, invalidated or rendered unenforceable, the Second Lien Agent and the other Second Lien Secured Parties shall hold any Collateral, Proceeds or distribution received on account of their Liens in trust for, and shall turn over the same to, the First Lien Agent until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, as if such Lien had not been so avoided, invalidated or rendered unenforceable.
S|Section 2.03 Prohibition on Contesting Liens; No Equal or Priming Liens.|The Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of each other Second Lien Secured Party, agrees that it shall not (and hereby waives any right to) contest or support any other Person in contesting, in any proceeding (including any Insolvency Proceeding), (a) the priority, validity, extent, perfection or enforceability of any Lien held by or on behalf of any of the First Lien Secured Parties in all or any part of the Collateral, or (b) the validity, amount or enforceability of any First Lien Obligations or any provision of this Agreement, and shall not seek to have any Lien securing any Second Lien Obligations equated with, made pari passu with, or primed ahead of, any Lien securing any First Lien Obligations. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to prevent or impair the rights of the First Lien Agent or any other First Lien Secured Party to enforce this Agreement, including the priority of the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations.
S|Section 2.04 After-Acquired Property; Automatic Second Priority.|If any Grantor acquires any property or asset after the date hereof on which a Lien is granted to secure any First Lien Obligations (including pursuant to Section 6.12(b) or 6.12(c) of the First Lien Credit Agreement), any Lien on such property or asset securing the Second Lien Obligations shall automatically attach, if at all, as a second-priority Lien, junior and subordinate in all respects to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, without any further action by any Person, and shall be subject in all respects to this Agreement. The priorities in Section 2.01 shall apply to all such after-acquired property and to all Proceeds thereof.
S|Section 2.05 No New Liens; Identical Collateral; Guarantees.|(a) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the parties hereto agree that no Second Lien Secured Party shall acquire or hold any Lien on any assets of any Grantor (or any other Person) securing any Second Lien Obligation that are not also subject to a first-priority Lien in favor of the First Lien Agent securing the First Lien Obligations. If any Second Lien Secured Party acquires or holds any Lien on any assets of any Grantor securing any Second Lien Obligation which assets are not also subject to a Lien in favor of the First Lien Agent, then the Second Lien Agent (or the relevant Second Lien Secured Party) shall, without the need for any further consent of any other Second Lien Secured Party, either (i) release such Lien or (ii) assign such Lien to the First Lien Agent as security for the First Lien Obligations (in which case the Second Lien Agent may retain a junior Lien on such assets subject to the terms hereof), and, pending such release or assignment, hold such Lien (and all Proceeds thereof) in trust for the First Lien Agent. (b) Nothing herein shall require the First Lien Secured Parties to hold Liens only on assets that are also Second Lien Collateral; the First Lien Secured Parties may hold Liens on assets that are not Second Lien Collateral, and the Second Lien Secured Parties shall have no rights in respect thereof. (c) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, no Person shall guarantee any Second Lien Obligations unless such Person has also guaranteed the First Lien Obligations, and each guarantee of the Second Lien Obligations shall be subordinated to the guarantee of the First Lien Obligations on the terms set forth in Section 12.02 of the Second Lien Credit Agreement and herein.
N|Collateral mismatch. S|Section 2.06 Similar Liens and Agreements.|The parties intend that the First Lien Collateral and the Second Lien Collateral be identical except as provided in Section 2.05(b). H|ARTICLE 3|ENFORCEMENT; STANDSTILL
S|Section 3.01 Restrictions on Enforcement by Second Lien Secured Parties.|(a) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has occurred, whether or not any Insolvency Proceeding has been commenced by or against any Grantor, the Second Lien Agent and the other Second Lien Secured Parties shall not, during the Standstill Period or at any time prior to the commencement of a Standstill Period (in each case except as expressly permitted by Section 3.03):
I|(i) accelerate, or demand payment of, the Second Lien Obligations (other than any automatic acceleration under Section 8.02(c) of the Second Lien Credit Agreement upon a Bankruptcy Event of Default (as defined therein), which shall not by itself constitute a breach of this Agreement);
I|(ii) commence or join with any Person in commencing or maintaining any Enforcement Action or other action or proceeding against or with respect to the Collateral, or institute any suit, action or proceeding with respect to such rights or remedies, including any action of foreclosure;
I|(iii) exercise or seek to exercise any rights or remedies with respect to any Collateral under the Second Lien Collateral Documents or any other Second Lien Document or applicable law;
I|(iv) commence, or join with any Person (other than the First Lien Agent) in commencing, any involuntary Insolvency Proceeding against the Borrower, Holdings or any other Grantor [at any time prior to the Discharge of First Lien Obligations]; or
I|(v) take any action to oppose, contest, hinder, delay or interfere with (A) any Enforcement Action or other exercise of rights or remedies by the First Lien Agent or any other First Lien Secured Party with respect to the Collateral, (B) the manner in which the First Lien Agent or any other First Lien Secured Party seeks to enforce or collect the First Lien Obligations or the Liens securing the same, or (C) any sale, transfer or other disposition of the Collateral by the First Lien Agent or by any Grantor with the consent of the First Lien Agent, whether by foreclosure or otherwise.
N|Per instructions, the five standstill restrictions are tied to the Standstill Period. Read literally, the instructions start the 180 days only upon delivery of an Enforcement Notice or Payment Blockage Notice by the First Lien Agent, which would mean that, absent a First Lien notice, there is no standstill at all and the Second Lien could enforce immediately upon its own Event of Default. Clause (a) therefore also prohibits Second Lien enforcement “at any time prior to the commencement of a Standstill Period,” and Section 3.02(a) starts the period upon the First Lien Agent’s receipt of a Second Lien Enforcement Notice if no First Lien notice has been delivered. The bracketed language in clause (iv) (prohibition on involuntary filings until Discharge) goes beyond the instructions; it is common in first-lien-favorable forms and is offered for your consideration. See Memo Issues 6 and 22.
P|(b) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has occurred, the First Lien Agent and the other First Lien Secured Parties shall have the exclusive right to commence and maintain any Enforcement Action and to make determinations regarding the release, disposition or restrictions with respect to the Collateral, in each case without any consultation with or the consent of the Second Lien Agent or any other Second Lien Secured Party. In exercising rights and remedies with respect to the Collateral, the First Lien Agent and the other First Lien Secured Parties may enforce the provisions of the First Lien Documents and exercise remedies thereunder, all in such order and in such manner as they may determine in the exercise of their sole discretion.
P|(c) Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Second Lien Agent and any Second Lien Secured Party may, to the extent not inconsistent with this Agreement: (i) file a claim or statement of interest with respect to the Second Lien Obligations in any Insolvency Proceeding commenced by or against any Grantor; (ii) take any action (not adverse to the priority status of the Liens on the Collateral securing the First Lien Obligations, or the rights of the First Lien Agent or the First Lien Secured Parties to exercise remedies in respect thereof) in order to create, perfect, preserve or protect (but not enforce) its Lien on the Collateral; (iii) file any necessary responsive or defensive pleadings in opposition to any motion, claim, adversary proceeding or other pleading made by any Person objecting to or otherwise seeking the disallowance of the claims of the Second Lien Secured Parties, in each case in accordance with the terms of this Agreement; (iv) vote on any plan of reorganization, subject to Section 6.10; and (v) receive Permitted Second Lien Payments in accordance with Article 4.
S|Section 3.02 Standstill Period.|(a) “**Standstill Period**” means the period commencing on the date of delivery by the First Lien Agent to the Second Lien Agent of an Enforcement Notice or a Payment Blockage Notice (or, if no such notice has been delivered prior to the date on which the First Lien Agent receives a Second Lien Enforcement Notice, the date on which the First Lien Agent receives such Second Lien Enforcement Notice) and ending on the date that is 180 days thereafter, as such period may be extended pursuant to Sections 3.02(b) and 3.02(c).
N|Standstill length. 180 days per instructions and the 1L CA definition of “Standstill Period.” Caldwell Reed proposed 90 days on the term sheet; we held at 180 and do not concede here. See Memo Part 5.
P|(b) Notwithstanding Section 3.02(a), the Standstill Period shall be extended (i) for so long as the First Lien Agent or the First Lien Secured Parties are diligently pursuing in good faith the exercise of their enforcement rights or remedies against, or diligently attempting to vigorously pursue or complete the collection, sale or other disposition of, all or any material portion of the Collateral (including commencement of any action to foreclose, any action to obtain possession of Collateral, notification of account debtors or the solicitation of bids for a sale of Collateral), and (ii) for so long as the First Lien Agent or the First Lien Secured Parties are stayed from pursuing such rights or remedies by operation of the automatic stay in any Insolvency Proceeding or any other court order.

Unlimited restarts are outside market norms and Caldwell Reed will reject them. Options: (1) include as drafted (conforms to 1L CA); (2) limit to one restart in any 360-day period; or (3) delete and rely on the diligent-pursuit and automatic-stay tolling in clause (b), which is market. S|Section 3.03 Exercise of Remedies After Standstill Period.|(a) After the expiration of the Standstill Period (as the same may be extended), and so long as the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has not occurred, the Second Lien Agent may exercise rights and remedies with respect to the Collateral under the Second Lien Documents, but only after delivering to the First Lien Agent not less than five (5) Business Days’ prior written notice of its intention to exercise such rights and remedies (specifying in reasonable detail the actions proposed to be taken); provided that, notwithstanding the expiration of the Standstill Period, in no event shall the Second Lien Agent or any other Second Lien Secured Party exercise or continue to exercise any rights or remedies with respect to the Collateral if the First Lien Agent or the First Lien Secured Parties have commenced and are diligently pursuing the exercise of their rights or remedies with respect to all or any material portion of the Collateral (in which case the Second Lien Agent shall cease and desist from any such exercise).

S|Section 3.04 Actions Upon Breach.|If any Second Lien Secured Party, contrary to this Agreement, commences or participates in any action or proceeding against any Grantor or the Collateral, such Grantor, with the prior written consent of the First Lien Agent, or the First Lien Agent, may interpose as a defense or dilatory plea the making of this Agreement, and any First Lien Secured Party may intervene and interpose such defense or plea in its or their name or in the name of such Grantor. Should any Second Lien Secured Party, contrary to this Agreement, in any way take, attempt to take or threaten to take any action with respect to the Collateral, or fail to take any action required by this Agreement, the First Lien Agent or any other First Lien Secured Party (in its own name or in the name of the relevant Grantor) may obtain relief against such Second Lien Secured Party by injunction, specific performance or other appropriate equitable relief, it being understood and agreed by the Second Lien Agent on behalf of each Second Lien Secured Party that (a) the First Lien Secured Parties’ damages from such actions may at that time be difficult to ascertain and may be irreparable and (b) each Second Lien Secured Party waives any defense that the Grantors or the First Lien Secured Parties cannot demonstrate damage or can be made whole by the awarding of damages.
H|ARTICLE 4|PAYMENTS; PAYMENT BLOCKAGE; APPLICATION OF PROCEEDS
S|Section 4.01 Permitted Second Lien Payments.|Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the Borrower and the other Grantors may make, and the Second Lien Secured Parties may receive and retain, only the following payments in respect of the Second Lien Obligations (the “**Permitted Second Lien Payments**”):
I|(a) regularly scheduled payments of cash interest on the Second Lien Term Loan, at the non-default rate of interest set forth in Section 2.04(a) and (b) of the Second Lien Credit Agreement as in effect on the date hereof (or as increased in accordance with Section 8.01(b)), on the scheduled Interest Payment Dates therefor, but only if, at the time of such payment and after giving effect thereto, no First Lien Payment Default and no First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing;

S|Section 4.03 Voluntary Prepayments of Second Lien Term Loan.|The Borrower may voluntarily prepay the Second Lien Term Loan, in whole or in part, and the Second Lien Secured Parties may receive and retain such prepayment, only if (a) no First Lien Payment Default and no First Lien Bankruptcy Default has occurred and is continuing or would result therefrom, and (b) the Borrower has delivered to the First Lien Agent, not less than three (3) Business Days prior to the date of such prepayment, a certificate of a responsible officer of the Borrower demonstrating in reasonable detail that, after giving pro forma effect to such prepayment (and any Indebtedness incurred and cash used in connection therewith), the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the most recently ended Test Period does not exceed 4.50 to 1.00. For purposes of this Section 4.03, the First Lien Net Leverage Ratio shall be calculated solely in accordance with the definition thereof in this Agreement (and not any definition in the Second Lien Credit Agreement), and the conditions in this Section 4.03 shall apply notwithstanding Section 2.06(a) of the Second Lien Credit Agreement.
N|At closing, Consolidated First Lien Net Debt is approximately $310,000,000 (revolver undrawn) against LTM Adjusted EBITDA of $89,200,000, or approximately 3.48x before cash netting, so the 4.50x test has roughly 1.0x of headroom at close. S|Section 4.04 Application of Proceeds.|So long as the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has not occurred, whether or not any Insolvency Proceeding has been commenced, all Collateral and all Proceeds thereof received by the First Lien Agent, the Second Lien Agent or any other Secured Party in connection with any Enforcement Action, any sale, transfer or other disposition of Collateral (including any sale under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code), any collection or other realization on the Collateral, any insurance or condemnation proceeds in respect of Collateral, or any distribution in any Insolvency Proceeding on account of the Collateral or the Liens thereon, shall be applied in the following order:

I|**Second**, to the Second Lien Agent for application to the payment of the Second Lien Obligations in accordance with the Second Lien Documents, until paid in full; and
I|**Third**, the balance, if any, to the Borrower or the applicable Grantor, or to whomever may be lawfully entitled to receive the same or as a court of competent jurisdiction may direct.
P|Any priority among the First Lien Secured Parties set forth in the First Lien Documents (including the priority of Protective Advances under Section 2.13(b) of the First Lien Credit Agreement) is solely among the First Lien Secured Parties and shall not affect the priority of the First Lien Obligations over the Second Lien Obligations.
S|Section 4.05 Asset Sales; Insurance and Condemnation.|(a) The Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it will not object to, oppose or otherwise contest (and will be deemed to have consented to) any sale, transfer or other disposition of Collateral (whether in or outside of an Insolvency Proceeding, and including any sale under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code) that is consented to by the Required First Lien Lenders (or the First Lien Agent at their direction), and the Liens of the Second Lien Agent on such Collateral shall be released as provided in Section 5.01. (b) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the First Lien Agent shall have the sole and exclusive right, subject to the rights of the Grantors under the First Lien Documents, to settle and adjust claims in respect of Collateral under policies of insurance and to approve any award granted in any condemnation or similar proceeding affecting the Collateral. If the Second Lien Agent or any Second Lien Secured Party receives any such proceeds or award in contravention of this Section 4.05, it shall pay the same over to the First Lien Agent. If, in connection with any such release, the First Lien Agent releases the Equity Interests of any Grantor, the guarantee of the Second Lien Obligations by such Grantor and all Liens on its assets shall be released as well.

P|(c) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of the other Second Lien Secured Parties, hereby irrevocably constitutes and appoints the First Lien Agent and any officer or agent of the First Lien Agent, with full power of substitution, as its true and lawful attorney-in-fact with full irrevocable power and authority in the place and stead of the Second Lien Agent or such holder or in the First Lien Agent’s own name, in the First Lien Agent’s discretion, for the purpose of carrying out the terms of this Section 5.01, to take any and all appropriate action and to execute any and all documents and instruments (including UCC-3 termination statements, mortgage releases and releases of guarantees) that may be necessary or desirable to accomplish the purposes of this Section 5.01. S|Section 5.02 Amendments to Collateral Documents; Legend.|Each Second Lien Collateral Document shall be subject to this Agreement. Any amendment, waiver or consent to the First Lien Collateral Documents (other than any amendment restricted by Section 8.01) shall apply automatically to any comparable provision of the comparable Second Lien Collateral Document, without the consent of any Second Lien Secured Party, so long as notice is given to the Second Lien Agent and such amendment does not (a) remove assets subject to the Liens of the Second Lien Agent except to the extent such release is permitted by Section 5.01, or (b) impose duties on the Second Lien Agent without its consent.
S|Section 5.03 Rights as Unsecured Creditors.|Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement, the Second Lien Agent and the other Second Lien Secured Parties may exercise rights and remedies as unsecured creditors against the Borrower and any other Grantor in accordance with the terms of the Second Lien Documents and applicable law; provided that (a) no such action shall be taken that is inconsistent with, or would contravene, the terms of this Agreement (including Sections 3.01, 4.01, 6.02, 6.04 and 6.10), and (b) in the event that any Second Lien Secured Party becomes a judgment lien creditor in respect of Collateral as a result of its enforcement of its rights as an unsecured creditor, such judgment lien shall be subject to the terms of this Agreement for all purposes (including in relation to the First Lien Obligations) to the same extent as all other Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations.
S|Section 5.04 No Duties of First Lien Agent; Waiver of Marshalling.|The First Lien Agent and the other First Lien Secured Parties shall have no duty to the Second Lien Secured Parties in connection with the management, sale, disposition or other realization of the Collateral, other than to remit any surplus Proceeds after the Discharge of First Lien Obligations in accordance with Section 4.04. The duties or responsibilities of the First Lien Agent under this Section 5.05 shall be limited solely to holding the Pledged Collateral as bailee and agent in accordance herewith. (c) Upon the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the First Lien Agent shall deliver the remaining Pledged Collateral (if any), together with any necessary endorsements, to the Second Lien Agent, or as a court of competent jurisdiction may otherwise direct, without recourse, representation or warranty.
S|Section 5.06 Insurance Proceeds and Related Matters.|Without limiting Section 4.05, the Second Lien Agent shall cooperate with the First Lien Agent to cause the loss payee and additional insured endorsements required by Section 4.05(b) to be delivered within the time periods required by the First Lien Credit Agreement.

H|ARTICLE 6|INSOLVENCY PROCEEDINGS
S|Section 6.01 Applicability; Subordination Agreement.|This Agreement shall be applicable both before and after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding by or against any Grantor and all references herein to any Grantor shall include such Grantor as debtor and debtor-in-possession and any receiver, trustee or similar Person for such Grantor. This Agreement is intended to be, and shall be interpreted as, a “subordination agreement” under Section 510(a) of the Bankruptcy Code and shall be enforceable in any Insolvency Proceeding to the same extent that it is enforceable under applicable non-bankruptcy law.
S|Section 6.02 DIP Financing and Use of Cash Collateral.|(a) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has occurred, if any Grantor shall be subject to any Insolvency Proceeding and the First Lien Agent shall desire to permit the use of “cash collateral” (as such term is defined in Section 363(a) of the Bankruptcy Code), or to permit any Grantor to obtain financing (whether from the First Lien Secured Parties or any other Person) under Section 364 of the Bankruptcy Code or any similar Bankruptcy Law (“**DIP Financing**”), then the Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it (i) will be deemed to have consented to, will raise no objection to, and will not support any other Person objecting to, such use of cash collateral or DIP Financing, (ii) will not request or accept adequate protection or any other relief in connection therewith, except as set forth in Section 6.04, and (iii) to the extent the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations are subordinated to or pari passu with such DIP Financing, will subordinate its Liens in the Collateral to the Liens securing such DIP Financing (and all obligations relating thereto, including any “carve-out” for professional fees and United States Trustee fees agreed to by the First Lien Agent) on the same basis as the Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations are subordinated to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations under this Agreement; provided that the aggregate principal amount of such DIP Financing (including any “roll-up” of pre-petition First Lien Obligations), together with the aggregate amount of all First Lien Obligations (other than First Lien Obligations Refinanced by such DIP Financing) then outstanding, shall not exceed the sum of (A) the aggregate amount of all First Lien Obligations outstanding on the date of commencement of such Insolvency Proceeding (including principal, all accrued and unpaid interest (including interest at the Default Rate), fees, premiums (including the Prepayment Premium), Protective Advances, reimbursement obligations in respect of letters of credit, Hedging Obligations, Cash Management Obligations, expenses and indemnities) plus (B) $30,000,000 (the “**DIP Cap**”), plus, in each case, Post-Petition Interest, fees and expenses accrued thereon and any “carve-out” described above; and provided further that such DIP Financing is secured by Liens on the Collateral having priority equal to or higher than the existing Liens securing the First Lien Obligations.
N|DIP cap (high priority). Drafted our way per instructions: outstanding First Lien Obligations plus $30,000,000 of new money, with room for accrued interest, fees and the revolver in a distress scenario. CONFLICT: 2L CA §9.18(b) consents to DIP Financing only up to “the aggregate principal amount outstanding under the First Lien Credit Agreement at the time of the filing … plus $30,000,000” — i.e., the principal-only cap that Trident proposed and we rejected. Caldwell Reed will cite §9.18(b) as the agreed deal. The ICA controls (2L CA §§6.03, 11.02(c); Section 1.03 above), but we should ask that §9.18(b) be conformed or expressly made “subject to the Intercreditor Agreement.” Illustration at close: principal-only cap ≈ $340,000,000 ($310,000,000 + $30,000,000); our cap also includes accrued interest, fees, the Prepayment Premium, hedge and cash management exposure and any revolver and Protective Advance draws. 2L CA §9.18(b) is also silent on cash collateral; Section 6.02 covers it. See Memo Issue 3.
P|(b) The Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it will not, and will not support any other Person to, directly or indirectly, (i) provide, offer to provide, seek or support any DIP Financing or use of cash collateral that is secured by Liens on the Collateral senior to or pari passu with the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations (or any First Lien DIP Financing), or that otherwise primes the First Lien Obligations, unless the Required First Lien Lenders have consented thereto in writing, or (ii) oppose or object to any First Lien DIP Financing or use of cash collateral on the basis that the First Lien Secured Parties are not adequately protected or on any other basis inconsistent with this Agreement.
P|(c) All First Lien DIP Financing (to the extent within the DIP Cap) shall constitute First Lien Obligations for all purposes of this Agreement.
S|Section 6.03 Relief from the Automatic Stay.|Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations, the Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that none of them shall seek relief from the automatic stay or any other stay in any Insolvency Proceeding in respect of the Collateral without the prior written consent of the First Lien Agent, or oppose any request by the First Lien Agent or any other First Lien Secured Party for relief from such stay.
S|Section 6.04 Adequate Protection.|(a) The Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that none of them shall contest (or support any other Person contesting) (i) any request by the First Lien Agent or the other First Lien Secured Parties for adequate protection or (ii) any objection by the First Lien Agent or the other First Lien Secured Parties to any motion, relief, action or proceeding based on the First Lien Agent or the other First Lien Secured Parties claiming a lack of adequate protection.
P|(b) In any Insolvency Proceeding, the Second Lien Secured Parties shall be entitled to seek and receive adequate protection solely in the following forms, and only if and to the extent the First Lien Secured Parties are granted adequate protection in the same form: (i) a replacement Lien on all or any part of the Collateral (including any additional or replacement collateral granted to the First Lien Secured Parties), which Lien shall be junior and subordinate in all respects to (A) the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations, (B) the Liens securing any DIP Financing consented to (or deemed consented to) under Section 6.02 (and any “carve-out”), and (C) all Liens and other adequate protection granted to the First Lien Secured Parties; and (ii) a superpriority administrative expense claim under Section 507(b) of the Bankruptcy Code, which claim shall be junior and subordinate in all respects to all superpriority administrative expense claims (including under Section 507(b) of the Bankruptcy Code) granted to the First Lien Secured Parties and any claims in respect of any DIP Financing consented to (or deemed consented to) under Section 6.02.
P|(c) In no event shall the Second Lien Agent or any other Second Lien Secured Party seek, request or accept adequate protection (i) in the form of any payment of cash (whether of interest, principal, fees, expenses or otherwise), (ii) in the form of any additional collateral, guarantee or Lien other than the replacement Lien described in Section 6.04(b)(i), or (iii) in the form of any administrative or superpriority claim that is equal or senior in priority to any administrative or superpriority claim of the First Lien Secured Parties or of any DIP Financing. Any adequate protection received by any Second Lien Secured Party in contravention of this Section 6.04 shall be held in trust and turned over to the First Lien Agent in accordance with Section 4.06. Any replacement Lien or superpriority claim granted to the Second Lien Secured Parties shall be subject to this Agreement.
N|Drafted cleanly per instructions: replacement Liens and junior superpriority claims only; no cash adequate protection, additional collateral or senior/pari administrative priority. Consistent with 2L CA §9.18(c) (adequate protection “solely” in the form of junior replacement Liens and junior superpriority claims), which does not, however, expressly prohibit cash payments; clause (c) makes the prohibition explicit. Caldwell Reed has asked for broader adequate protection rights; we have not conceded. See Memo Issue 20.
S|Section 6.05 Sale of Collateral; Section 363.|The Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it will not object to or oppose (or support any other Person objecting to or opposing) a sale or other disposition of any Collateral (or any portion thereof) under Section 363 of the Bankruptcy Code or any other provision of the Bankruptcy Code if the Required First Lien Lenders (or the First Lien Agent on their behalf) shall have consented to such sale or disposition, and shall be deemed to have consented under Section 363(f) of the Bankruptcy Code to any such sale or disposition (and to the release of its Liens in connection therewith), and will not raise any objection under Section 363(e) of the Bankruptcy Code or otherwise, so long as the Proceeds thereof are applied in accordance with Section 4.04 and the Liens of the Second Lien Agent attach to such Proceeds with the same priority as provided herein. The Second Lien Agent and the other Second Lien Secured Parties shall not credit bid any Second Lien Obligations in connection with any such sale unless the bid provides for the Discharge of First Lien Obligations in cash at the closing of such sale.
S|Section 6.06 Section 1111(b); Section 506(c); Post-Petition Interest.|(a) The Second Lien Agent, for itself and on behalf of the other Second Lien Secured Parties, waives any claim it may hereafter have against any First Lien Secured Party arising out of the election by any First Lien Secured Party of the application of Section 1111(b)(2) of the Bankruptcy Code, and agrees that it shall not make (or support) any such election in respect of the Second Lien Obligations without the consent of the First Lien Agent. H|ARTICLE 6|INSOLVENCY PROCEEDINGS
S|Section 6.01 Applicability; Subordination Agreement.|This Agreement shall be applicable both before and after the commencement of any Insolvency Proceeding by or against any Grantor and all references herein to any Grantor shall include such Grantor as debtor and debtor-in-possession and any receiver, trustee or similar Person for such Grantor. S|Section 6.02 DIP Financing and Use of Cash Collateral.|(a) Until the Discharge of First Lien Obligations has occurred, if any Grantor shall be subject to any Insolvency Proceeding and the First Lien Agent shall desire to permit the use of “cash collateral” (as such term is defined in Section 363(a) of the Bankruptcy Code), or to permit any Grantor to obtain financing (whether from the First Lien Secured Parties or any other Person) under Section 364 of the Bankruptcy Code or any similar Bankruptcy Law (“**DIP Financing**”), then the Second Lien Agent, on behalf of itself and the other Second Lien Secured Parties, agrees that it (i) will be deemed to have consented to, will raise no objection to, and will not support any other Person objecting to, such use of cash collateral or DIP Financing, (ii) will not request or accept adequate protection or any other relief in connection therewith, except as set forth in Section 6.04, and (iii) to the extent the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations are subordinated to or pari passu with such DIP Financing, will subordinate its Liens in the Collateral to the Liens securing such DIP Financing (and all obligations relating thereto, including any “carve-out” for professional fees and United States Trustee fees agreed to by the First Lien Agent) on the same basis as the Liens securing the Second Lien Obligations are subordinated to the Liens securing the First Lien Obligations under this Agreement; provided that the aggregate principal amount of such DIP Financing (including any “roll-up” of pre-petition First Lien Obligations), together with the aggregate amount of all First Lien Obligations (other than First Lien Obligations Refinanced by such DIP Financing) then outstanding, shall not exceed the sum of (A) the aggregate amount of all First Lien Obligations outstanding on the date of commencement of such Insolvency Proceeding (including principal, all accrued and unpaid interest (including interest at the Default Rate), fees, premiums (including the Prepayment Premium), Protective Advances, reimbursement obligations in respect of letters of credit, Hedging Obligations, Cash Management Obligations, expenses and indemnities) plus (B) $30,000,000 (the “**DIP Cap**”), plus, in each case, Post-Petition Interest, fees and expenses accrued thereon and any “carve-out” described above; and provided further that such DIP Financing is secured by Liens on the Collateral having priority equal to or higher than the existing Liens securing the First Lien Obligations.

Caldwell Reed will cite §9.18(b) as the agreed deal. I drafted a first-lien-favorable intercreditor agreement for the CTS deal, with 26 bracketed AKM drafting notes and a 23-item closing issues memo (ranked by priority) at the front; it validates and parses back cleanly. The biggest catch is a date error: the Second Lien Credit Agreement (§9.18(j)(i)) and the partner email both say 91 days after First Lien maturity is July 16, 2031, but the correct date is January 14, 2032. The memo also flags the principal-only DIP cap, the plan-voting carve-out and the different leverage-ratio definitions in the Second Lien Credit Agreement, and a gap that would leave no standstill if the First Lien never sends a notice. I had no Meridian precedent in the materials, so the draft uses a market first-lien form and still needs conforming to Meridian.
